skipReason.in_other_run: already in another run for this period

runs.newHint: Takes the active external workers in scope who have a rate. Daily and hourly quantities are suggested from the kiosk; weekly, monthly and yearly quantities are entered.
runs.title: Title

rates.title: Rates
rates.hint: Each external worker's rate: an amount, a currency and a unit. A change applies from its date; earlier periods keep the rate they had.
rates.noConversion: Amounts are never converted between currencies or units.
rates.empty: No external workers in your scope.

policy.ruleHint: How a monthly or yearly rate becomes a day rate, for adjustments entered in days.

basisOption.calendar: the calendar days of the period
basisOption.working: the working days of the period

policy.ruleNote: Monthly: rate / days. Yearly: rate / 12 / days. The rule used is stored with each approval.
policy.itemsHint: Applied to every worker before approval: a fixed amount in a currency (only for workers paid in that currency), or a percentage of gross.
policy.name: Name

run.draftNote: Draft - not approved. Exports carry a draft mark.
run.frozenNote: Approved: these figures are frozen. Later changes to rates or the policy do not affect them; changing them needs a reopen with a reason.
run.currencyNote: Each currency has its own total; currencies are never added together.
run.empty: No workers in this pay run.
run.quantityNote: Reason (required when it differs from the kiosk)
run.daysConverted: Days x the day rate ({{rule}}; fixed days: {{divisor}}).
run.amountOnlyUnit: For weekly and hourly rates, enter an amount.
run.reopenHint: The approved version stays on record; a new version is prepared.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.noAuthority: You do not have this external labour pay permission for this scope.
errors.notInPlan: External workers are not in your plan.
errors.changedBySomeoneElse: Someone else changed this. Reload and try again.
errors.quantityReason: Give a reason when the quantity differs from the kiosk attendance.
errors.approvedReopenFirst: This pay run is approved. Reopen it first.
errors.quantitiesMissing: Enter every worker's quantity before approving.
errors.amountOnly: For this rate unit, enter the adjustment as an amount.
errors.positive: Enter a value greater than zero.
errors.noWorkers: This pay run has no workers.
errors.cannotDelete: Only a draft that was never approved can be deleted.

addRateFailed: The worker was added, but the rate was not saved: {{error}}. Set it under External labour pay.
